mmsa.LOCAL_SITE_HARDWARE_FAULT: Site repeatability differs. Review the current measurement evidence before assigning a cause.
mmsa.TEST_RESOLUTION_OR_METHOD: Review measurement resolution and repeatability across sites.
mmsa.SYSTEMATIC_SITE_SHIFT: Site means differ under the configured comparison. Review the measurements and site setup.
mmsa.SITE_VARIANCE_ANOMALY: Site spread differs under the configured comparison. Review the measurements and site setup.
mmsa.CLOSE_TO_LIMIT_MARGIN: The mean is close to a specification limit. Review the specification and measurement distribution.
mmsa.DISTRIBUTION_WIDE_OR_BIMODAL: Review the measurement distribution. These statistics do not establish bimodality.
mmsa.DISTRIBUTION_OR_LIMIT_REVIEW: Review the distribution and specification limits.
mmsa.S2S_EVIDENCE_INCONCLUSIVE: The site comparison is inconclusive. Engineering review is required.

unavailable.MISSING_UNIT: Unit is not recorded; verify the test definition. This does not identify a digital test.
unavailable.NO_EFFECTIVE_LIMIT: CPK requires an effective specification limit.
unavailable.NO_EFFECTIVE_TWO_SIDED_LIMIT: Cg requires effective two-sided specification limits.
unavailable.INVALID_LIMIT_ORDER: Specification limits are invalid or reversed.
unavailable.ZERO_OR_UNAVAILABLE_STD: Standard deviation is zero or unavailable. Capability cannot be calculated.
unavailable.TOO_FEW_VALID_SAMPLES: There are too few valid samples for the configured evaluation.
unavailable.TOO_FEW_USABLE_SITES: Site Diff requires at least two sites with valid statistics.
unavailable.INCOMPLETE_SITE_COVERAGE: Selected site coverage is incomplete. Cg acceptance is not evaluated.
unavailable.NO_SELECTED_EXECUTION: No test execution exists in the selected records.
unavailable.FUNCTIONAL_TEST: Capability statistics do not apply to functional tests.
unavailable.NON_PARAMETRIC_TEST: Statistical outlier screening does not apply to functional tests.
unavailable.ZERO_ROBUST_SPREAD: Robust spread is zero. An outlier baseline cannot be calculated.
unavailable.MISSING_OR_INVALID_CHANNEL: Head or site identity is unavailable. The outlier baseline cannot be evaluated.
unavailable.GATE_NOT_TRIGGERED: The configured gate does not require a Site Diff evaluation.
unavailable.NO_MATCHED_BIN1_CPK: Matching evaluable CPK/Cg support is unavailable.
unavailable.MISSING_CG: Cg is unavailable. Capability acceptance cannot be evaluated.
